# EdCloud Venture Partners

> Operator-led growth consulting for post-traction education technology companies scaling across K-12 and higher education.

EdCloud Venture Partners (EdCloud, LLC) helps education technology companies scale from foothold to national ubiquity with buyer-centric positioning, sales systems, procurement support, pricing optimization, partnerships, and RevOps infrastructure. Trusted by teams at Handshake, Clever, Outschool, and Wayfinder.
